name: Reactive Fire
desc: First round deals double damage. Triggers every 7.5s max for a 0.5s duration.

name: Tough as Nails
desc: Adds 40 life and 0,5 health regeneration /s.

name: Quick Thinking
desc: Reduces reload and unjam time by 30%.

name: Energetic
desc: Increases energy regeneration by 0.5/s.

name: Hawk Eye
desc: Increases weapon range by 2 and adds 15 range invisible detection.

name: Always Ready
desc: Start at level 3, begin with quik clot, smoke grenades, flares, and an ammo case.

name: Twinkle Toes
desc: Increases movement speed by 0.06.

name: Discipline
desc: 12% increase in XP gain.

name: Intellectual
desc: Adds 5 to mechanical skills.

name: Born to Lead
desc: (Aura) Adds 8% bonus damage.

name: Barbaric
desc: Start with rifle butt unlocked.

name: Instructor
desc: (Aura) Adds 6% attack speed, 0.03ms, and improves reload/unjam time by 15%.

name: Self-Sufficient
desc: Self-Aid heals 5/s during 15s, and has 67% chance to cure moderate ailments.

name: Power User
desc: Start with energy cells, and improves energy cell efficiency by 50%.

name: Whiz Kid
desc: Increases damage with explosives by 30%.

name: Battle Buddy
desc:
Start with a random mini soldier.
If this mini dies, he will be revived 10 minutes later in PMC and PMC+, 7 minutes later in other modes.

With a hero lvl 5 or better, all your minis will gain +0.1 health regeneration/s and +0.05 move speed.
With a hero lvl 10 or better, the bonus become +0.2 health regeneration/s and +0.1 move speed.

Unlock:
detain the Dr Jashan in Nightmare+ difficulty.
or
kill the specimen wihtout any dead in the fight, and no one mind controlled in Nightmare+ difficulty.

choices.name: Combat Engineer
choices.note:
You will get Rory Swann if you pick this one as a Combat Engineer.
(1 max per game)

choices.name: Medic
choices.note:
You will get Stetman, if you pick this one as Combat Medic or Phoenix Medic.
(1 max per game)

choices.name: Jim Raynor
choices.note: You have be in Thalim to choose this mini.

choices.name: Sarah Kerrigan
choices.note: You have be in Balaad to choose this mini.

name: Veteran
desc: Reduces life by 55%, increases damage 30% and 0.05ms.

name: Light Armor
desc: Reduces life by 15%, but increases MS by 0.1.

name: Heavy Armor
desc: Increases life by 20% and shield by 20 (+1 shield regeneration), but reduces MS by 0.07.

name: Combat Load
desc:
Increases maximum magazine capacity before encumbrance to 24 mags/2400 fuel.
Provides an ammo box containing 4 mags, and a flash light.

name: Lonely Soldier
desc:
Provides bonus when alone in a range of 10, or malus if there is at least two other soldiers that close (are counted only biological units owned by an ally or neutral ; your own minis and LNs will trigger the malus).

Bonus Lonely :
Move Speed +0,08
Attack Speed +18%
Health Regeneration +0,2/s
Weapon Range +1

Malus Not Lonely :
Move Speed -0,12
Attack Speed -30%
Weapon Range -1

Unlock : win Hard mode with T1 modifier (available for every MOS).

Disabled if less than 3 players.

name: Strong Together
desc:
Provides bonus when there is at least 3 other soldiers in a range of 10, or malus if there is less than 3 other soldiers that close (are counted only biological units owned by an ally or neutral ; your own minis and LNs are NOT counted).

Bonus Strong Together :
Move Speed +0,08
Attack Speed +15%
Health Regeneration +0,5/s
Weapon Range +1
Aura +0.025 movement speed, +4% attack speed (4 stacks max)

Malus Weak Alone :
Move Speed -0,10
Attack Speed -23%
Weapon Range -1

Unlock : win Insane mode with Outbreak modifier (available for every MOS).

Disabled if less than 3 players.

name: Legion Born
desc: Reduces life by 55%, increases attack speed by 25% and 0.05ms.

name: Field Support
desc:
[Rifleman] Improves Frag Grenades, Smoke Grenades and Flares.

Unlock : win Nightmare+ mode playing a Rifleman.

name: Blood in Blood Out
desc:
[Combat Medic] Improves Blood Transfusion and Nano-Injection.
Sets the chance to apply a self augmentation when applying it to an other unit to 80%.

Unlock : win Nightmare+ mode playing a Medic.

name: Steel Saber
desc:
[Cav Scout] Adds damage, range, and suppresses weapon.

Unlock : win Nightmare+ mode playing a Cavalry Scout.

name: Not Magic but Science
desc:
[Engineer] Improves bots (inventory or stealth), message when bots or sentries are destroyed, recall Bots ability, timer for satchels.
Sentries : +15% damage, 410 HP, +1 armor.
Repair drains 0,1 energy/s.
Barricade CD : 55s.

If you build an IsBot without this SI, then take this SI, you will have to build a new IsBot to get its inventory.

Unlock : win Nightmare+ mode playing an Engineer.

name: Guess who is behind you
desc:
[Ghost] Cloak 3s/2.5s/2s/1.5s/1s
Damage +50%, attack speed +50% decloaking, for 2 seconds.
Combat Fitness: 1 health regeneration, 0.2 movement speed increase.

Unlock : win Nightmare+ mode playing a Ghost

name: Sky is the Way
desc:
[Fire Support Specialist] Replace the AWT by a powerful Liberator.

AH-25 Hunter
- 1100 health
- armor 6
- speed 3.25
- sight radius 15
- damage 175+ at 0.125s
- duration 6s

Liberator
- 1800 health
- armor 8
- speed 4
- sight radius 20
- damage 360 at 0.2s
- Heal aura +5 health /s
- 50% chance to reduce explosion damage (self only)
- duration 8s

Unlock : win Nightmare+ mode playing a FSS.

name: Firmware Updates
desc:
[Cyborg] Every 10 minutes, the Cyborg gains a buff (stacks 7 times max):

- Reduces reload time by 0.1s.
- Agi 1: +0.01 attack speed, +0.004 move speed
- Agi 2: +0.02 attack speed, +0.008 move speed
- Agi 3: +0.03 attack speed, +0.012 move speed
- Strength 1: +0.3 health regeneration
- Strength 2: +0.6 health regeneration
- Strength 3: +0.9 health regeneration
- Perception 1: +1 range for detection
- Perception 2: +1.5 range for detection
- Perception 3: +2 range for detection
- Stealth 1: -0.05 energy cost over time
- Stealth 2: -0.1 energy cost over time
- Stealth 3: -0.15 energy cost over time

Unlock : win Nightmare+ mode playing a Cyborg.
